knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Combustible load near heat, combined with blocked routes, raises both the chance and the consequence of a fire.
The worker records and escalates. Moving the stack or handling the board is outside this lesson.
FRV recommends risk reduction as a priority rather than large scale removal.

practicalCriteria: In a described or photographed training scene, the learner identifies at least two combustible loads near ignition points and records them without touching anything.
The learner writes the escalation note with location, time and the referral named in the plan.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Any stack, lead or appliance is touched or moved to check it.
A fire-load hazard is recorded but not escalated.
